deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: release=redwood-inference-api@v1.12.0 target=prod change_window=2026-03-20T23:00Z-2026-03-21T01:00Z executor=@alex.k
oncall-sre: Heads up — we're still getting elevated error rates from the earlier incident in #incidents. 5xx spike hasn't fully trended down. Recommend holding any non-critical deploys. :warning:
alex.k: Acknowledged. This is a non-critical release (metrics/observability tweaks + a few batching configs). Will hold if you think it's risky.
maria.p: +1 on hold until incident fully stabilized. Product prefers to avoid extra variables during post-incident window.
ops-lead: Can we pin the rollout so we don't accidentally auto-retry during the holding window?
release-coordinator: If we hold, we should reschedule to the next change window (23:00-01:00 UTC) two days out. Need to update release notes and notify support.
oncall-sre: hold applied by oncall-sre via command: `deploy-bot hold --release redwood-inference-api@v1.12.0 --reason "incident_followup"`
deploy-bot: Hold acknowledged. Status=ON_HOLD release=redwood-inference-api@v1.12.0 initiated_by=oncall-sre reason=incident_followup
alex.k: Thanks — pinning image digest now to prevent automatic drift: `docker tag sha256:abcdef -> redwood-inference-api@v1.12.0-pin-1992102468`
maria.p: Can we set a canary-only rollout when we re-schedule? Keeps blast radius low.
ops-lead: Agreed. Plan: reschedule to 2026-03-22T23:00Z, canary 10% for 30m, then 100% if healthy. I will create the reschedule ticket and update the calendar.
release-coordinator: I've updated the release tracking doc and notified support channels. Release notes: "Observability improvements; batching config tweaks." No customer-facing changes.
oncall-sre: When incident is closed I'll post an all-clear here. Until then, leaving hold in place.
deploy-bot: Reminder: automated rollback protection remains enabled. If the incident escalates deploys will stay blocked for the next change window.
alex.k: Copy. Will not re-trigger deploy until we get the all-clear. Tagging @maria.p for final signoff when cleared. :white_check_mark:
maria.p: Will review after incident close and confirm. Thanks for the quick coordination.
oncall-sre: Incident degraded metrics trending down: error_rate 5xx from 4.2% -> 1.1% in 35m, but not under pre-incident baseline yet. Still holding.
release-coordinator: Updated calendar invite to 2026-03-22T23:00Z with canary plan and rollback steps.
ops-lead: If anything changes we'll loop back here.
deploy-bot: Thread archived by deploy-bot action=hold_applied thread_ts=1992102468
